review_notes: Independently reviewed the current top-level proposal.json, not merely the librarian packet in context. Read all 161 proposal lines, all 34 functionality lines, all 525 fact-disposition lines and all 539 link-disposition lines.

All seven proposed fact writes concern owned subjects, have supported source-level values, and correspond to the seven superseded baseline facts. The proposal contains no new links, entities, merges or follow-ups.

Read both owned files completely in canonical and rendered form, all four subject pages and all three outgoing-link pages. Independently checked the cited stage helpers, statistics accessor, consuming fighter query, Wait input/collision consumers, Fox/Falco motion tables, throw-bit helper, common physics/collision helpers and callback dispatch sites.

The proposal correctly distinguishes the six-slot any-nonzero scan from an accumulated count or proven once-per-match lifecycle. It preserves the exact held_buttons[0] and x682 conditions without assigning an unsupported input-history interpretation.

The exact equality-based row selection, exceptional floating-point cases, zero-based phase boundary, unguarded corrupted indices, event consumption order and optional stage branches are accurately represented.

Callback registration overwrites the slot only after a true helper result; false results leave it unchanged. Cleanup clears the slot after the stage call. The proposal correctly avoids claiming universal startup, lifetime-wide one-shot execution, reentrancy protection or explicit normal-exit cleanup.

Retained purpose and gameplay-association claims are accepted only at their broad operational scope. Exact dialogue terminology/content, complete presentation teardown, statistic lifetime, external motion semantics and compiled layout remain explicitly deferred below.
No replacement proposal or artifact mutation was performed.

Broad special-taunt orchestration is supported. Startup is conditional; exact dialogue content and complete normal-exit behavior remain deferred.

The eight parameter subjects have no baseline facts. Source signatures establish pointer roles, not compiled r3 bindings or object-layout offsets.

Exact one-frame down-D-pad semantics require x682 producers and input-history update ordering. The verified condition is only absence of HSD_PAD_DPADDOWN in input.held_buttons[0] together with x682 == 1.
Once-per-match enforcement requires by_attack_hi[0x72] producers, reset points and record lifetime. The owned scan only proves rejection while any of six current entries is nonzero.
Complete pl_80040120 semantics, the meaning of x221F_b4 in that call and its relationship to recording statistic 0x72 remain unresolved.

Full callback lifetime across external transitions, resets, natural stage completion and rearming remains unresolved. Local normal animation completion does not explicitly clear death1_cb. Post-call clearing is not a reentrancy guarantee.
